title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CONTROLLER relative to the State of California Department of Tax and Fee Administration Audit of the City of Los Angeles' sales and…
text:
[Council File 26-1496]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CONTROLLER relative to the State of California Department of Tax and Fee Administration Audit of the City of Los Angeles' sales and use tax for the period of June 1, 2013 to June 30, 2019.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. AUTHORIZE the Controller to transfer the amount of $3,043,863 from the General/Reserve Fund to the Unappropriated Balance and therefrom to Fund No. 837 Sales Tax Trust, Account No. 2031, Use Tax Payable.
2. AUTHORIZE the Controller to pay $3,043,863 to the California Tax and Fee Administration in reference to Account No. SU AA 011-300003.
3. REQUEST that each department reimburse the City for its prorated portion of the assessed liability, attachment 3, attached to the Controller report dated October 1, 2026, attached to the Council file.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Controller. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Budget and Finance Committee waived consideration of the above matter.)

outcome.text: Council action: Adopted, Forthwith (Oct 30, 2026); Council action final
